what: The raw --json output apkleaks 2.6.3 wrote when it was run over the committed planted-secrets APK. The head-to-head comparison row grades the apkleaks side against this file, so the row is measured against what the third-party tool actually produced on every machine, with no install and no network.
decompiler_note: apkleaks shells out to the first jadx on PATH and scans that decompiled tree. 1.5.5 is the version evidence/competitors/versions.lock pins and evidence/competitors/install-linux.sh installs, so the capture and the documented install agree.
environment: PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8, jadx bin directory first on PATH
verify: pip install apkleaks==2.6.3 && jadx --version (expect 1.5.5) && run `command` and diff the result against the committed output
